description:
Maximize your nursery floor space with the French Country Chest from Old Time Oak. This tall, graceful storage piece offers multiple dovetailed drawers in a vertical footprint that fits beautifully in smaller nurseries while providing surprising storage capacity.
Each drawer features smooth full-extension glides for easy access and dovetail construction for lasting durability. The solid wood frame with signature French Country detailing, including turned legs and decorative hardware, brings warmth and character to your nursery. The top drawer is perfect for small essentials, while the larger lower drawers accommodate clothing, blankets, and more.
The compact footprint makes this chest ideal for tight spaces, but its generous storage capacity means you never have to compromise. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish throughout. Coordinates with the full French Country collection of cribs, nightstands, and dressers for a beautifully cohesive nursery.
